name: chat-hive
description: A real-time chat application built with MERN stack and Socket.io
author: Owais Ahmad Shah

scripts.build: pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:client
scripts.build:server: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter server build
scripts.build:client: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter client build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter client lint && pnpm --filter server lint
